title: LA 573 ube: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: LA 573 ube: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: LA 573 ube is an ube variety. About 7.5 months to harvest, 11.2 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: LA 573 is a registered ube variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2007 as NSIC 2007 GY 07. It takes about 7.5 months from planting to harvest, with 11.23 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** about 7.5 months from planting to harvest.
**Yield:** 11.23 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

LA 573 ube takes about 7.5 months from planting to harvest. That is about the average of the 8 ube varieties with a day count, 7.6 months. Count the months from planting, and plan the harvest for a dry stretch when you can.

Its average yield of 11.23 t/ha trails the average of its group, 16. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit ube fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [mealybug](/pests/mealybug), [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its roots have light purple flesh and light maroon skin. Dry matter is 22.73 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne.
Where and when to plant LA 573 ube
Processors pay for a deep purple flesh that stays purple when cooked. Pick a registered variety for color and yield, and plant whole small tubers or setts.

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 7.5 months from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 11.23 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of LA 573?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
